# Chicken or Hero: sound setup

Open **SoundService → GameAudio** in Studio. Everything is connected. A first-pass Toolbox selection now fills **52 of the 56 slots**, using **23 distinct free Creator Store assets**.

Lobby and Match music remain ready for your Suno tracks. The optional continuous ClothesRustle and SprintWind loops remain empty; I did not find a confidently suitable seamless loop. All other slots have trial effects, including future-map surface footsteps.

The technical playback checks passed. These are metadata-guided selections, not a listening-approved final mix. Listen in the game and replace or clear any SoundId you dislike. **Volume** and **PlaybackSpeed** remain directly editable in Studio.

See [the selection manifest](audio-selections.md) for every source, ID, volume and pitch. Each filled Sound also has SourceName, SourceCreator, SourceURL and TrialSelection attributes.

## Start here

1. **01_Soundtracks → Lobby** — your loopable lobby instrumental.
2. **01_Soundtracks → Match** — your loopable match instrumental.
3. **02_Movement → Footsteps → Grass** — one short grass footstep/scuff.
4. **05_Rounds → CountdownTick** — a short countdown tick.
5. **05_Rounds → RunStart** — the group crossing's GO/bell sound.
6. **05_Rounds → SpawnRefresh** — arriving at a round spawn.
7. **05_Rounds → LobbyReturn** — returning to a lobby spawn.
8. **03_Catching → DiveStart / DiveLand / CatchImpact** — dive launch, ground landing and confirmed contact.
9. **04_UI → Click** — a short button click.

These are the highest-priority slots to audition or replace. You do **not** need to use all 56 slots.

## Adding and removing a sound

- Set **SoundId** to `rbxassetid://YOUR_NUMBER`, using audio permitted for this experience.
- **Volume** controls that sound's loudness. **PlaybackSpeed** adjusts its speed/pitch.
- Leave **Playing** off. The controller plays local copies at the appropriate moment.
- Each Sound's **Purpose** attribute explains its event and the kind of recording to find.
- Clear **SoundId** to turn it off. Unfilled optional slots make no sound and do not block the game.
- Surface variants fall back to Grass when unfilled; CountdownFinal falls back to CountdownTick; LandHard falls back to LandSoft.
- Music, ClothesRustle and SprintWind are loops. Other slots are short one-shot sounds. The controller enforces this so an accidentally looped click cannot continue forever.
- Sounds longer than 12 seconds are cut off as a safeguard; use the soundtrack slots for long music.
- Edit in normal Studio Edit mode, then publish for live servers. Edits made during Play are temporary.

The folder also contains **00_READ_ME** with these basic instructions.

## Folder layout

| Folder | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| 01_Soundtracks | Only Lobby and Match music, as agreed |
| 02_Movement | Surface footsteps, starting/stopping, turns, boost, landings, optional rustle/wind |
| 03_Catching | Dive launch/landing/recovery, actual catch impact, private catch feedback |
| 04_UI | Button hover/click, choice panels and notices |
| 05_Rounds | Countdowns, crossing starts/ends, refreshes, match results |

## Footsteps

Use **one short footstep**, not a recording of someone walking for several seconds. The controller repeats it at the active walk/run animation's contact phases, with a speed/distance fallback if a recognizable animation is unavailable. Small pitch variation reduces repetition. Exact contact timing and tone can be tuned during the listening pass.

Own footsteps have priority. Other players' steps start at **18% volume**, are positional, and fade out within **36 studs**. Only the nearest characters are processed. This is a starting mix choice, not a rule that all games follow.

Current grass parts are Plastic in Roblox's material properties. They now have **AudioSurface = Grass**, without changing their physical material. Future maps use actual materials automatically. For an artistic surface override, give a floor part an **AudioSurface** string attribute matching a slot: Grass, Concrete, Sand, Dirt, Wood, Metal, Snow or Water.

Grass is the fallback for unfilled/unknown surfaces. Optional clothing rustle and sprint wind remain separate from foot contact.

## Music and mixing

Lobby players hear Lobby music even while a match is running. Participants switch to Match music during preparation and keep it through the results. Music crossfades over **1.2 seconds** and does not restart at every round, teleport or respawn.

**SoundService → GameAudioMixer** has separate Music, Movement, Catching, UI, Rounds and PlayerEvents volume controls. These multiply the individual Sound volumes.

Technical tuning is in **ReplicatedStorage → ChickenOrHero → Audio → AudioConfig**. This includes remote-player volume, distance limits, contact phases and music fade time. No gameplay configuration needs changing to replace audio.



## Recap and danger audio
04_UI/MatchSummary: Reveal, CountTick and CountComplete. 07_Danger/ApproachingCatcher: quiet accelerating heartbeat tied to the existing visual threat detector. It fades out on escape, catching, death, teleport, role changes or when opponents retreat. Volume can be changed per Sound or through GameAudioMixer/Danger. Clear a SoundId or set Enabled=false for silence. ReachedSafety now uses a short rising reward cue; its prior settings are saved in PreviousSoundId/PreviousVolume/PreviousPlaybackSpeed. These additions are metadata-selected; verify the final mix by ear. There is still no general match music.
